dct_description_sm: Angola administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 3 levels: - Admin 1: 18 Province - Admin 2: 161 Municipality - Admin 3: 539 nan Dates associated with this dataset: - 28 January 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 04 September 2018: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 30 August 2018: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 30 August 2018: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Regional Office for Southern and Eastern Africa (ROSEA)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-rosea). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
dct_publisher_sm: www.gadm.org and Instituto Nacional de Estatística (INE - www.ine.gov.ao) - see methodology
